title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers that add up to target.
solution_python:
import sys
data=sys.stdin.read().split()
nums=list(map(int,data[:-1]))
t=int(data[-1])
seen={}
for i,n in enumerate(nums):
  c=t-n
  if c in seen: print(seen[c],i); break
  seen[n]=i

title: Palindrome Check
description: Check if a string is a palindrome (reads same forwards and backwards, ignoring non-alphanumeric).
solution_python:
import sys
s=sys.stdin.read().strip()
c=''.join(x.lower() for x in s if x.isalnum())
print('true' if c==c[::-1] else 'false')

title: Fibonacci Number
description: Return the Nth Fibonacci number. F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2).
solution_python:
n=int(input())
a,b=0,1
for _ in range(n):a,b=b,a+b
print(a)

solution_python:

print(sum(1 for c in s if c.lower() in 'aeiou'))

title: Binary Search
description:
Implement binary search on a sorted array. Return the index of target or -1 if not found.

Line 1: space-separated sorted integers.
Line 2: target.
solution_python:
import sys
lines=sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
nums=list(map(int,lines[0].split()))
t=int(lines[1])
l,r=0,len(nums)-1
res=-1
while l<=r:
  m=(l+r)//2
  if nums[m]==t:res=m;break
  elif nums[m]<t:l=m+1
  else:r=m-1
print(res)

title: Anagram Check
description: Given two strings on separate lines, return 'true' if one is an anagram of the other, else 'false'.
solution_python:
import sys
lines=sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
a,b=lines[0],lines[1]
print('true' if sorted(a)==sorted(b) else 'false')

title: Merge Sorted Arrays
description:
Given two sorted arrays on separate lines, merge them into one sorted array and print it.

Line 1: first sorted array (space-separated)
Line 2: second sorted array (space-separated)
constraints: Both arrays sorted in non-decreasing order
hints: Pick the smaller element at each step
solution_python:
import sys
lines=sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
a=list(map(int,lines[0].split())) if lines[0].strip() else []
b=list(map(int,lines[1].split())) if len(lines)>1 and lines[1].strip() else []
res=[]
i=j=0
while i<len(a) and j<len(b):
  if a[i]<=b[j]:res.append(a[i]);i+=1
  else:res.append(b[j]);j+=1
res+=a[i:];res+=b[j:]
print(*res)
